# China Robotics Insider

> China Robotics Insider is an independent English-language publication covering China's robotics industry — founders, companies, products, development history and the supply chain behind the world's largest humanoid ecosystem.

> Site: https://www.robotichina.com
> Key topics: humanoid robots, robot supply chain, actuators, reducers, sensors, LiDAR, clean room robots, educational robots, robot vacuums, industrial robots

- [China's Coreless Motor Suppliers](https://www.robotichina.com/china-coreless-motor-suppliers.html): The heart of the dexterous hand — China's coreless motor suppliers breaking Maxon's monopoly.
- [China's Force & Tactile Sensor Suppliers](https://www.robotichina.com/china-force-tactile-sensor-suppliers.html): Touch sensors went from bottleneck to global lead — China's force and tactile sensor suppliers ranked.
- [China's Encoder Suppliers](https://www.robotichina.com/china-encoder-suppliers.html): The eyes of every joint — who's closing Heidenhain's encoder gap in China.
- [China's Planetary Reducer Suppliers](https://www.robotichina.com/china-planetary-reducer-suppliers.html): Torque for the heavy joints — Zhongda Leader's 3.2B RMB Unitree contract and the challengers.
- [The China Humanoid Supply Chain: A Complete Guide](https://www.robotichina.com/china-humanoid-supply-chain.html): The pillar guide to China's humanoid supply chain — who leads every component in 2026.
- [China's Clean Room Robots: The Machines Behind Chip Fabs](https://www.robotichina.com/china-clean-room-robots.html): US$1.7B market, 20.8% CAGR — Topstar, SIASUN and Estun move wafers in China's fabs.
